M3 x 10 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.

events.text:
Cabinet built as a 3-high vertical stack of half-hex bases (North half) at 0,0 levels 0-2. Drawers installed on the bottom (level 0) and top (level 2) cut faces; middle cell remains as closed cabinet body. Top drawer set open to show pulled-open state, bottom drawer closed.

**Requirements:**
- Cabinet of three cells: **met** — three piece cells stacked vertically (piece:0,0,0;half-n, piece:0,0,1;half-n, piece:0,0,2;half-n) forming a 3-storey cabinet, capped and joint-locked.
- Two drawers: **met** — drawers installed at level 0 (drawer:0#0,0#cut) and level 2 (drawer:2#0,0#cut) on the half-base cut faces.
- One of them shown pulled open: **met** — setDrawerOpen on the level-2 drawer to true (open), level-0 drawer left closed; verified in view.

House rules applied: capOpenFaces and lockJoints executed; meshClash clear, no errors.

Outcome: built
